preconditions.description: Number of test cases is between 1 and 20,000.
Number of bricks in each test case is between 3 and 200,000.
Weight of each brick is between 1 and 1,000,000,000.

postconditions.description: Each test case produces exactly one output line.

postconditions.expression: for each test case: output is an integer
postconditions.description: The output is an integer representing the maximum possible final score.
